items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 110:1
items.html: Since they could not be sorted into the discernment of complete vessels for the clothing of holiness, except the first three vessels, KHB, because ZON separated to a garment and hall — therefore only the discernment of the three vessels of the brain, bones, and sinews are considered complete, inner vessels, that is, that the light clothes in them completely. But the two Partzufim of flesh and skin became outer vessels in the Partzuf. Therefore there are inner NRN, which clothe in the inner vessels, and there are outer Nefesh and Ruach, which clothe in the outer vessels mentioned above. And from the drops of the coupling of the inner vessels come out the souls of human beings, and from the drops of the coupling of the outer vessels come out the souls of the angels. (Item 168).
